title: Record the V45 single-lowering margin
body:
## Summary
- Group V45 lowers helpers 249, 251, 265 and 267 onto one rank-7 subspace. Each recorded end frame is a hyperplane of a rank-8 frame.
- With the pinned break-even 2091300, one helper loses by 53141, two by 27770, and three by 2399. All four pay by 22972.
- Every helper end frame in the stage-1 record is rank 8 to 7. The claimed exponent, the cleanup buffers, and both supplier caps are not replayed.
